/images/ceh/m02-04-01-dns-journey-zh.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0204-f1-zh-title m0204-f1-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0204-f1-zh-title">圖 1｜DNS 的角色與查找</title>
<desc id="m0204-f1-zh-desc">裝置詢問解析器；需要時沿委派找到權威答案。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0204-f1-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 1｜DNS 的角色與查找</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">裝置 → 遞迴解析器</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">可能先使用仍有效的快取</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0204-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">需要查找：根 → TLD 指引</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">不是每次都走完整路徑</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0204-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">權威伺服器：負責自己的區域</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">提供所管理紀錄的答案</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0204-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">解析器回覆裝置</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">保留來源、類型、時間與 TTL</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">箭頭是簡化查找順序，不是所有封包</text>
<text x="300" y="600" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">TTL 是快取期限，不是全球更新保證</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-04-02-record-roles-zh.sv:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0204-f2-zh-title m0204-f2-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0204-f2-zh-title">圖 2｜紀錄不同，問題不同</title>
<desc id="m0204-f2-zh-desc">分清位址、別名、郵件與區域角色，不推論所有權。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0204-f2-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 2｜紀錄不同，問題不同</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">A / AAAA：IPv4 / IPv6 位址</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">入口位址不一定是原始主機</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0204-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">CNAME：另一個名稱的別名</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">服務依賴不等於資產歸屬</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0204-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">MX：收信路由；TXT：文字用途</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">郵件路由不等於寄件者身分</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0204-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">NS / SOA：區域服務與管理資訊</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">PTR：反向名稱，不是所有權證明</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">虛線是分類比較，不是 DNS 查詢流程</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-04-03-registration-zh.sv:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0204-f3-zh-title m0204-f3-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0204-f3-zh-title">圖 3｜註冊角色與資料限制</title>
<desc id="m0204-f3-zh-desc">註冊管理機構、註冊商與註冊人是不同角色；遮蔽欄位保留未知。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0204-f3-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 3｜註冊角色與資料限制</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Registry：管理頂層網域登錄</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">不是每個網站的營運者</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0204-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Registrar：提供網域註冊服務</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">不能直接當作網站擁有人</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0204-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Registrant：註冊持有人角色</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">公開資料可能遮蔽或不完整</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0204-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">RDAP：讀角色、事件類型與來源</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">缺資料就記未知，不猜身分</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">虛線表示角色判讀，不是持有關係鏈</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-04-04-evidence-boundary-:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0204-f4-zh-title m0204-f4-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0204-f4-zh-title">圖 4｜線索到防護的界線</title>
<desc id="m0204-f4-zh-desc">查詢會產生互動；保留條件並將觀察與推論分開。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0204-f4-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 4｜線索到防護的界線</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">先確認：名稱、服務、授權範圍</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">第三方託管不自動納入授權</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0204-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">記錄：時間、解析器、類型、狀態</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">逾時不等於 NXDOMAIN</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0204-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">判讀：事實、假設、尚未證實</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">公開入口不等於原始主機</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0204-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">防護：管理帳號、紀錄、存取控制</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">DNSSEC 驗真與完整性，不是加密</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">變更後依來源與快取條件核驗</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-04-01-dns-journey-en.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0204-f1-en-title m0204-f1-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0204-f1-en-title">1 | DNS roles and lookup</title>
<desc id="m0204-f1-en-desc">A device asks a resolver; delegation leads to authoritative data when needed.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0204-f1-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">1 | DNS roles and lookup</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Device → recursive resolver</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">May use a still-valid cached answer</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0204-f1-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">When needed: root → TLD referral</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Not every lookup takes the full path</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0204-f1-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Authoritative server: its own zone</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Answers for the records it serves</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0204-f1-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Resolver replies to the device</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Keep source, type, time, and TTL</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Arrows simplify lookup order, not every packet</text>
<text x="300" y="600" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">TTL limits caching; it is no global update promise</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-04-02-record-roles-en.sv:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0204-f2-en-title m0204-f2-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0204-f2-en-title">2 | Different records, different questions</title>
<desc id="m0204-f2-en-desc">Separate addresses, aliases, mail, and zone roles; do not infer ownership.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0204-f2-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">2 | Different records, different questions</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">A / AAAA: IPv4 / IPv6 addresses</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">An entry address may not be the origin</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0204-f2-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">CNAME: alias of another name</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">A dependency does not prove ownership</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0204-f2-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">MX: inbound mail; TXT: text data</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">A mail route is not sender identity</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0204-f2-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="456" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">NS / SOA: zone service and management</text>
<text x="300" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">PTR: reverse name, not ownership proof</text>
<text x="300" y="575" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Dashed arrows compare roles, not a query sequence</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m02-04-03-registration-en.sv:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 640" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0204-f3-en-title m0204-f3-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0204-f3-en-title">3 | Registration roles and limits</title>
<desc id="m0204-f3-en-desc">Registry, registrar, and registrant are different roles; redacted data stays unknown.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0204-f3-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="638" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">3 | Registration roles and limits</text>
<rect x="40" y="65" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="96" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Registry: manages a TLD registry</text>
<text x="300" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Not the operator of every website</text>
<path d="M300 153V185" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0204-f3-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="185" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="216" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Registrar: provides domain registration</text>
<text x="300" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Not automatically the website owner</text>
<path d="M300 273V305" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0204-f3-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="305" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="336" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Registrant: registration holder role</text>
<text x="300" y="363" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Public data may be redacted or incomplete</text>
<path d="M300 393V425" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#m0204-f3-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="40" y="425" width="520" height="88" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
